task.instruction: Show the scores and main highlight of the Milwaukee Bucks game that took place within the last 2 days on ESPN.

final_answer:
**Milwaukee Bucks 102 – Boston Celtics 109** (Final) — Thursday, Nov 5, 2026, at TD Garden in Boston. This is the Bucks' only game in the last two days (they were not on the Nov 6 slate).

**Score by quarter**

| Team | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | T |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bucks (MIL) | 14 | 27 | 38 | 23 | **102** |
| Celtics (BOS) | 28 | 34 | 25 | 22 | **109** |

**Main highlight:** The Bucks erased a 22-point second-quarter deficit and briefly took their first lead of the game at 92-91 on a Nate Ament free throw with under eight minutes left. But Boston answered late — Derrick White converted a hoop-and-harm three-point play to put the Celtics up 102-97 with 2:22 remaining, and Boston outscored Milwaukee 12-5 over the final three minutes to close it out.

**Top performers:** Paul George led Boston with 25 points and five 3-pointers, Derrick White added 24 points and seven assists, and Baylor Scheierman had nine points and 11 rebounds off the bench. For Milwaukee, Tyler Herro scored 25 (18 of them in the third quarter) and Jaime Jaquez Jr. added 18. The Bucks fell to 1-7 (0-4 on the road); Boston improved to 6-2 and 5-0 at home. Note: ESPN's video page for this game shows "No Videos Available," so the highlight above is drawn from the game recap rather than a video clip.

judge.rationale: The agent used ESPN pages showing Bucks-Celtics 109-102 on Nov 5, checked Nov 6 for no Bucks game, and cited ESPN recap details for the main highlight.
